headline: Romania recorded the second-highest economic growth in the EU in the third quarter, says Luca Niculescu
summary: Prime Minister Luca Niculescu said Romania recorded the second-highest economic growth in the European Union in the third quarter. He made the statement at the AmCham Romania Forum.
why: GDP growth rates are a key indicator for sovereign risk, currency and bond investors assessing an economy. Comparisons with EU peers shape views on relative performance.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: România a înregistrat a doua cea mai mare creștere economică din UE în trimestrul III, spune Luca Niculescu
